title: CI typecheck pipelines and incremental builds
hook: **CI pipelines** run `tsc -b` or `tsc --noEmit`, typed eslint, tests — pin TypeScript version, cache `.tsbuildinfo`, fail-fast before merge.

blocks.text: install → lint → typecheck → test → build. Cache node_modules + tsbuildinfo. **Pin exact typescript** in package.json. Vite build may skip tsc — separate typecheck job required. --pretty false for CI logs.
TS version drift wastes hours. No typecheck merges any. Monorepo without tsc -b cache times out Actions.

blocks.title: Interview trap: build passes types OK
blocks.body: esbuild transpileOnly / vite may skip types — dedicated tsc job.

sections.heading: How it works step by step

items.title: pin typescript
items.body: Pin exact typescript version in package.json and commit lockfile — CI must not float minor versions silently.

items.title: parallel lint+tsc
items.body: Run eslint and tsc -b in parallel CI jobs or sequential stages with shared node_modules cache.

snippet.label: package scripts
GitHub Actions
snippet.code:
jobs:
  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with: { node-version: 20, cache: npm }
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck

snippet.label: Cache tsbuildinfo
snippet.code:
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: "**/*.tsbuildinfo"
    key: tsc-${{ hashFiles("**/tsconfig*.json") }}
